newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Bogota stocks close barely higher in active trade.
newsitem.headline: Bogota stocks close barely higher in active trade.

text.p: Bogota's IBB index edged up a wafer-thin 0.02 percent to 1,199.90 on volume of 23 billion pesos in trading dominated by pocket to pocket dealing in Banco Ganadero.
The Medellin stock exchange reported technical difficulties preventing timely publication of closing figures of its IBOMED general price index.

Ganadero, the nation's largest bank in terms of assets, remained stable at 400 pesos on volume of 18.6 billion in Bogota. Medellin traders said Ganadero closed down 1.25 pesos to 395 pesos on volume of 197 million.
"There were large pocket to pocket cross deals in Ganadero," a Bogota trader said. "The same package of more than 21 million shares was traded twice."
Bank officials were not immediately available for comment.
Foreign funds also traded heavily in insurance giant Compania Suramericana de Seguros, flagship of the powerful Sindicato Antioqueno, dealers said.
Suramericana remained stable at 28,200 pesos on volume of 3.4 billion pesos in Bogota. Dealers said Suramericana rose 0.71 percent in Medellin to 28,200 on volume of 3.6 billion.
